objective: Validate transfer of a frozen semi-empirical turbine VIV closure to an unseen combined sweep-plus-dihedral blade-tip geometry over 11 high-fidelity FSI operating conditions.

resolved_viv_definition.rule: A point is in the resolved finite VIV interval when its peak amplitude is at least 0.5 times the maximum peak amplitude for that geometry; the interval is the contiguous sampled component containing the peak.

acceptance.curve_rule: RMSE over all 11 holdout peak amplitudes, normalized by the maximum holdout target amplitude, must be <= 0.30.
acceptance.peak_inclination_rule: The predicted and target peak inclinations may differ by at most one 2.5-degree sampling interval.
acceptance.finite_interval_rule: The onset and collapse of the predicted and target resolved VIV intervals may each differ by at most one 2.5-degree sampling interval.
acceptance.frequency_rule: At each target point in the resolved VIV interval, abs(predicted_f/fn-target_f/fn) must be <= 0.10.
acceptance.aggregate_rule: All curve, peak-amplitude, peak-location, finite-interval, and resolved-frequency gates must pass. Every one of the 11 holdout operating points must remain visible in the evidence table and plot.

freeze_rule.metadata_correction: The source coauthor list was corrected after the first frozen assessment; no target, role, equation, threshold, prediction, or metric changed.
required_before_holdout_evaluation: all fitted coefficients and training rows
freeze_rule.no_retuning: No equation, coefficient, geometry rule, input, or scoring threshold may be changed after the 11 COMB targets are evaluated while retaining a validation claim.
freeze_rule.failure_policy: A failed frozen assessment is preserved. If COMB values are subsequently used for fitting, COMB becomes training and a different untouched validation dataset is required.
freeze_rule.blindness_boundary: The published targets are public and have been digitized, so this is a locked holdout from fitting rather than a blinded experiment.

claim_boundary.supports: Multi-condition high-fidelity numerical wind-turbine validation of edgewise response amplitude, lock-in frequency, and finite inclination interval for one completely held-out combined tip geometry.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: Experimental validation, arbitrary blade-profile extrapolation, H-VAWT validation, spanwise load validation, rainflow/DEL agreement, fatigue life, or certification.
claim_boundary.h_vawt_promotion: H-VAWT preparation may proceed only after a frozen model passes this protocol and the heldout discrepancy is propagated as a conservative engineering uncertainty factor.
